_instructions: This file is a TEMPLATE and authorizes nothing.  Its status field is not
AUTHORIZED and aws_supervisor_r4.validate_authorization_record refuses it;
preflight_r4.py P9 executes that refusal as a required control.
To authorize: (1) obtain a different-model hostile source PASS of this
packet and record its report path, SHA-256 and model in reviewer_pass,
with verdict spelled exactly PASS -- no other spelling, case or spacing
is accepted, and any model name that normalises to contain 'opus' is
refused as the producer;  (2) obtain the coordinator GO; (3) fill every
<...> sentinel with the live host's exact values; (4) set status to
AUTHORIZED; (5) freeze the file root-owned 0444; (6) set the live EC2 tag
jc2-d43-k0-field-cert-authorization-sha256 to this file's SHA-256.
The preregistration status is never edited.
One authorization authorizes at most one launch, ever, and R4 enforces
that on both sides of the privilege boundary.  ROOT, via the unit's FIRST
ExecStartPre=+ mint_claim_r4.sh, mints at most one claim per digest:
<sealed parent>/spent/<digest>.spent is created with O_EXCL before
anything else exists, so a second start of the unit dies at
MINT_ALREADY_SPENT.  The UNPRIVILEGED supervisor then takes at most one
consumption lease, <run_path>/.jc2-k0-r4-authorization-<digest>.lease,
inside the service-owned run directory, last, after every precondition has
passed.  A crashed or NO_VERDICT run retires this record; a retry needs a
new record, a new digest and a new live tag.
DEPLOYMENT ORDER.  There is exactly ONE launch path and it is the unit.
a. root creates <run_path>'s parent directory, root-owned, mode 0755,
symlink-free, with no group- or world-writable ancestor;
b. root freezes THIS file 0444 root-owned and sets the live tag;
c. root installs systemd_unit_template_r4.service root-owned 0444 with
every <...> sentinel filled in.  <ABSOLUTE_RUN_DIRECTORY> is this
record's run_path and appears in the mint, the dry run, ReadWritePaths
and the retirement; drop-ins are forbidden;
d. OPTIONAL, and the only step that costs nothing: ops may run, as jc2k0,
custody_selftest_r4.py --pre-mint-advisory --run-path <run_path>
--authorization <this file>.  It is read-only, it mints nothing, and
it REFUSES (PREMINT_ALREADY_MINTED) once the run directory or the
spent marker exists, so it can never be run in place of the unit's own
dry run.  Skipping it changes no guarantee;
e. systemctl start jc2-d43-k0-field-cert-r4.service.  This is the only
launch action.  The unit then runs, in one atomic sequence:
1. ExecStartPre=+  root mint (one-shot, spent marker first);
2. ExecStartPre=   jc2k0, in the unit's sandbox, the on-host dry run
custody_selftest_r4.py --on-host-dry-run, which calls the
supervisor's own verify_custody_preconditions and takes no lease;
a non-zero exit aborts the start before ExecStart=;
3. ExecStart=      jc2k0, the supervisor: verify, then lease, then
stage the source and run both engines;
4. ExecStopPost=+  root retirement, which seals the run directory.
NEVER run mint_claim_r4.sh by hand.  There is no external mint and no
external dry run: a hand mint spends the digest and the unit's own
ExecStartPre then dies MINT_ALREADY_SPENT before the supervisor starts.
That was the R3 review's blocking finding and it is why this order has one
step (e) and no separate mint.
WHAT A REFUSAL COSTS.  Step (d) costs nothing.  Everything from step (e)
onwards does not: the mint has already spent the digest by the time the dry
run and the supervisor execute, so a refusal at step e.2 or e.3 retires
this record exactly as a crashed run does, and a retry needs a new record,
a new digest and a new live tag.  The lease is what a failed precondition
never takes; the digest is already gone.
run_path names a directory that root creates DURING step e.1, for this
exact authorization: owned by jc2k0 with mode exactly 0700, holding the
root-owned 0444 claim token and nothing else.  It must not exist before
step (e).  The supervisor creates no directory anywhere.

It must not exist before the unit is started.  The supervisor verifies all of that and creates nothing; see README, 'The R4 choreography'.
